bio.en: Product Engineer with over 8 years of experience, rooted in TypeScript backend and DevOps. I build end-to-end products: mobile apps, backends and the infrastructure behind them. I practice agentic engineering: I design the system, direct the agents that implement it, and review and own every change.
bio.es: Product Engineer con más de 8 años de experiencia, con base en backend TypeScript y DevOps. Construyo productos de punta a punta: apps móviles, backends y la infraestructura que los sostiene. Practico agentic engineering: diseño el sistema, dirijo a los agentes que lo implementan, y reviso y respondo por cada cambio.
